source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide when a triangle's area is half of a related rectangle's area and use decomposition to justify it.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Rectangle area is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide when a triangle's area is half of a related rectangle's area' is answered as rectangle area rather than triangle area.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Rectangle area is what produces triangle area, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide when a triangle's area is half of a related.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: triangle area is settled by running 'Decide how to find the area of an irregular figure by dividing it into': The area of a composite figure can be found by dividing it into rectangles and triangles — on the item about Decide when a triangle's area is half of a related.

intelligence.enrichment: A triangle formed by a rectangle's diagonal has half the area of that rectangle; a triangle can also be decomposed into halves of rectangles to show that its area is half of the associated rectangle.
